instruction: Design a circuit that behaves like a dual-edge triggered flip-flop. The circuit should have a single input port for the clock and a single input port for the data. The circuit should output a single value that represents the state of the flip-flop. You are not allowed to use @(posedge clk or negedge clk) or any other non-standard Verilog syntax. Instead, you must use only standard Verilog syntax and components.
label: clean
